faq.subtitle: Simple answers to make things clear.

items.q: Is the platform suitable for beginners?
items.a: Absolutely. Northpeak ships with a guided setup, sensible defaults and plain-language insights, so you don't need a data team to get value on day one.

items.q: How accurate are the AI insights?
items.a: Our models are continuously evaluated against your historical outcomes. You always see the confidence level behind each recommendation, so you stay in control.

items.q: Can I integrate with my existing tools?
items.a: Yes. Northpeak connects to the platforms you already use in seconds, with no engineering work required for the most common integrations.

items.q: What security measures do you have?
items.a: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access controls and audit logging. Your data is never used to train shared models.
Dashboards refresh in near real-time as new data arrives, and strategic insights are recalculated on a rolling schedule throughout the day.

items.q: What kind of support do you offer?
items.a: Every plan includes support. Advanced and Enterprise plans add priority and 24/7 channels, plus a dedicated specialist for onboarding.
